sloka: त्वम् च धर्मात् अतिक्रान्तः कथम् शक्यम् उपेक्षितुम् ।गुरु धर्म व्यतिक्रान्तम् प्राज्ञो धर्मेण पालयन् ॥४-१८-२४॥
transliteration: tvam ca dharmāt atikrāntaḥ katham śakyam upekṣitum ।guru dharma vyatikrāntam prājño dharmeṇa pālayan ॥4-18-24॥

translations.english: 'Wise Bharata being a respectable king rules by dharma. By the command of Bharata, we are bent upon punishing those who have strayed from dharma by being addicted to sensual pleasures.
